title: UI Conventions
intro: MTG Arena is the reference for Beryl's flow, motion, timing, table layout and wording (AGENTS.md, UI; [Project 50k](project-50k.md), K22). This page lists only what Arena does not settle: where Beryl differs on purpose, what Arena has no equivalent for, and what the recordings do not show.

The rulings were made on 2026-11-10 from an audit of 180 bug reports against the recordings in `~/arena`. Each Arena finding cites the recording moments that show it, as `<recording id> <time>`, for `just video film`.
This page is generated from `data/ui-conventions.json` (K28) by `just conventions`: edit the data, not the page. The repo lane fails when the page is stale.

sections.heading: Beryl exceptions
intro: Beryl does these and Arena does not. A bug report from the user adds, changes or removes an entry; nothing else does.

sections.heading: Settled as Arena
intro: Arena's way stands where an earlier report asked for something else, so do not restore the old behavior.

sections.heading: Not seen in Arena
intro: Built from motions and shapes Beryl already has. Arena has these, but the recordings do not show them.

sections.heading: Still open
intro: To be settled from the recordings (Project 50k, presentation track). Until then the current behavior stays.

entries.name: Phase icons
entries.rule: Twelve icons, two rows of three on each side of the life total, filled where a stop is set, the same rows for both seats.

arena.does: Arena shows one row above the action button.

entries.name: Full cards that tap
entries.rule: A permanent is its whole card and turns when it taps.

arena.does: Arena shows a crop of the art.

entries.name: No question before a choice
entries.rule: Never ask a yes or no whose answer the next screen could take: open the search, chooser or payment with a way to decline.

arena.does: Arena asks "Search your library…?" first.

entries.name: Target arrows by relationship
entries.rule: Red at something an opponent controls, green at your own. This is skin, listed so nobody removes it.

arena.does: Arena draws every target arrow cyan, whoever controls either end; its one red line is an opponent's declared attack, with a red chevron under the attacker.

entries.name: Lands unstacked until seven
entries.rule: Each land is separate until its controller has seven or more; then same-named lands stack.

arena.does: Arena piles same-named lands from the second copy, a tapped pile apart from an untapped one, and a pile of four shows "x4".

entries.name: Linked exile under its host
entries.rule: A card exiled "until this leaves the battlefield" sits tucked under the permanent that exiled it.

arena.does: Arena shows no link on the table.

entries.name: Own-target warning
entries.rule: Confirm before a counter or removal spell targets the player's own spell or permanent.

entries.name: Tokens
entries.rule: They appear at their slot; they do not fly out of their source.

arena.does: Arena's appears whole with a short glow, about 0.1 s after its ability leaves the stack; a batch appears as one group.

entries.name: Permanents that leave
entries.rule: A permanent that is not a token dissolves where it is: destroyed, it breaks into ash at its slot; exiled, it becomes a vortex there. Nothing flies to the pile.

arena.does: A destroyed creature glows and falls to ash over about 0.7 s; the spell then goes to its graveyard.

entries.name: Choosing how to cast
entries.rule: A card or permanent with more than one way to cast or use it opens a modal, "Choose One", showing the card once per option, with Cancel: an adventure, an alternative cost, a land's abilities.

arena.does: Brazen Borrower, Bonecrusher Giant and Force of Will open it from hand, Wasteland on the battlefield.

entries.name: A finished ability
entries.rule: It is removed at once, with no fade.

entries.name: Wording
entries.rule: Arena's exactly: "All Attack", "Choose attackers."

entries.name: Button order
entries.rule: It follows Arena prompt by prompt; there is no blanket "default on the right".

entries.name: The opponent's turn
entries.rule: Arena's "Opponent's Turn" label shows in the action button's place, and no spinner.

entries.name: Attacking a planeswalker
entries.rule: No prompt: an attacker defaults to the player, and the player pulls an arrow to the planeswalker.

arena.does: Attackers that can attack get a cyan outline; a clicked attacker turns gold, the opponent's life total and the planeswalker glow, and an arrow follows the cursor to the planeswalker.

entries.name: Two items on the stack
entries.rule: The top one still gets its target arrow.

arena.does: A cyan arc runs from the top item to its target, even when that is the one card under it; the top card sits a little right of and below the one beneath.

entries.name: Additional costs
entries.rule: A chooser that lowers the mana to pay (Delve) opens before mana taps; a sacrifice cost is chosen after the lands tap.

arena.does: Treasure Cruise's Delve chooser opens before any land taps; Natural Order's lands send their mana, then "Sacrifice a green creature." opens.

entries.name: A countered spell
entries.rule: It leaves before the spell that countered it.

arena.does: The countered spell crumbles in place under the counterspell, which stays until the debris is gone and then fades, 0.5 to 0.9 s later.

entries.name: Cards the opponent looks at
entries.rule: They come off the top of their library face down at library size and lie beside it; a top-bound card slides back onto the library and a bottom-bound one slides away from it, to either side. A pill above their avatar reads "Scry: 1 top, 1 bottom." for about 2.5 s.

arena.does: No card is enlarged.

entries.name: A line from an ability to its source
entries.rule: It is always shown while the ability is on the stack, thin and faint as Arena draws it, and hidden during a prompt. A heavy arrow is not that line.

entries.name: Passing to the end step
entries.rule: "End Turn" passes until the end step, but stops when the opponent puts a spell or ability on the stack: the button reads "Resolve", then "Pass" once it resolves.

arena.does: The button reads "End Turn" over "To End", and goes blank while it passes.

entries.name: Targeting a spell
entries.rule: With one spell on the stack, a spell that targets a spell takes it with no prompt and no Confirm. With more, a "Choose One" browser of the stack, "Target a spell.", opens with nothing preselected, Submit and Cancel.

arena.does: Counterspell and Mana Leak at a lone spell go straight onto the stack; Spell Pierce over two spells opens the browser at "Submit 0".

entries.name: Mana into what it pays for
entries.rule: Each tapped land glows and sends one streak of its color straight to the spell on the stack, which flashes as they land, in about 0.3 s. Mana does not stop at a pool.

arena.does: Seen for casts paid with lands.

entries.name: The local player's scry
entries.rule: A full-screen overlay, "Scry", shows the cards face up in one fan before a card back, BOTTOM on the left and TOP on the right, and Done; surveil's has Graveyard and Library boxes instead. On Done the overlay closes at once and nothing flies out of it: the cards show at the library at its size for a moment, and a pill reads "Scry: 1 top, 1 bottom."

arena.does: Seen for a scry of two and for surveil; no card changes face.

entries.name: A card a look puts in the graveyard
entries.rule: It appears on the graveyard at pile size once the chooser closes; it is not shown large first.

arena.does: A surveilled card lands on the graveyard as the overlay closes; kept cards close with the overlay.

entries.name: A batch exile
entries.rule: Cards exiled together leave one at a time, about 0.3 s apart.

arena.does: Delve's cards gather on the graveyard, then peel off its top one by one into a vortex. Delve is the only batch exile in the recordings, all in one recording.

entries.name: An opponent's spell returned to hand
entries.rule: It breaks up in place on the stack over 0.5 to 1 s; it does not fly or flip toward their hand.

arena.does: Seen for Remand on the opponent's spells.

entries.name: Hover inspection
entries.rule: A hovered card in hand rises and grows in place to about twice its size. A hovered permanent gets a separate copy about three times its size, away from the cursor, with its keywords explained. A card on the stack gets none.

arena.does: Estimated from stills, not measured.

entries.name: Undo
entries.rule: Every answer can be undone, across turns and prompts, the cast and its payment together.

entries.name: Chrome
entries.rule: Round icon buttons; the log toggle top left; the bug button above undo with no gap kept for a missing button.

entries.name: Why a click is refused
entries.rule: An illegal click shows its reason at the permanent that forbids it.

entries.name: Suggestions are sensible
entries.rule: The suggested untap targets and the auto-pay sources are the ones a player would pick.

entries.name: Nothing overlaps
entries.rule: The hand, the stack and their indicators never cover a control or each other. No layer of a library, graveyard or exile pile covers a card in play, for either seat, however long a row grows. The opponent's piles keep the band above their back row to themselves.

entries.name: Paying with permanents
entries.rule: Waterbend, convoke, crew. Start with no payment highlights. Hover over Auto Pay on desktop or long-press it on mobile to see which permanents Beryl would use. Click or tap the button to accept. To pay manually, click or tap each permanent you want to contribute. For a three-creature Convoke, pick A, B and D directly even if Auto Pay would use A, B and C. After each manual pick, recalculate the proposal for the remaining cost and keep the player's picks. Let the player finish manually or accept Auto Pay for the remainder, and stop taking picks once the cost is covered. Arena documents the preview and acceptance gestures in its [May 23, 2019 patch notes](https://devtrackers.gg/magic-arena/p/3e5941f1-may-23-0-15-00-00-patch-notes). A selected permanent turns and carries a tap mark, and an outline means one thing at a time.

entries.name: A creature that enters attacking
entries.rule: It gets an explicit choice of what it attacks, and its line stays drawn throughout.

entries.name: A token that leaves
entries.rule: It dissolves in place like any permanent. No token leaving the battlefield is seen.

entries.name: Evoke and cycling
entries.rule: A card with evoke, or a land with cycling, opens the same "Choose One" modal. No evoke is seen; Triomes cycle straight to the stack, but whether a land could still be played is not shown.

arena.does: Arena shows no chooser before these cycles.

entries.name: Known cards in a library
entries.rule: A known top card shows face up on its library, and clicking a library lists its known cards. No known card in the opponent's library is seen.

arena.does: The player's own library stays a card back after their tutor puts a card on top, and after a look.

entries.name: A card turning face up
entries.rule: A face-down permanent turning face up enlarges in place and flips; one leaving reveals its face during its flight. Nothing turns face up in the recordings, and one face-down card is seen leaving.

arena.does: Killed, Arena's face-down card dissolves as a card back and a "Revealed Cards" panel then shows its face at the top left.

entries.name: Cards a look returns
entries.rule: Cards a look puts back into a library fly straight to it. No look at several cards with the rest returned is filmed.

entries.name: A linked exile returning
entries.rule: The exiled card returns as its source departs, moving with it. No exiling permanent is seen leaving with its card returning.

entries.name: Your own spell returned to hand
entries.rule: It glides from the stack to the hand, turning as it goes. Only the opponent's spells are seen returned.

entries.name: The phone
entries.rule: It plays what the desktop plays; its layout and gestures are Beryl's own.
